ideas.title: Minnesota DHS Payment Freeze: A Deeper Look
ideas.description: Investigate the causes and effects of the 100-day payment freeze affecting Minnesotans with disabilities.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and examine the administration of funds by Minnesota DHS.
questions: What is being done to resolve the issue?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover systemic issues within Minnesota DHS and potentially lead to reforms or further investigations.

ideas.title: The Scope of Pandemic Relief Fraud
ideas.description: Explore the extent of pandemic relief fraud, focusing on the Feeding Our Future case and other similar investigations.
ideas.angle: Analyze the data and identify patterns in pandemic relief fraud cases.
questions: How widespread is pandemic relief fraud?
What are the common schemes and tactics used by fraudsters?
What can be done to prevent future fraud?
ideas.insight: This story could provide a comprehensive overview of pandemic relief fraud and highlight areas for improvement in fraud prevention and detection.
